# FGP Commercial Leasing

> FGP Commercial Leasing provides comprehensive tenant representation, site selection, lease negotiation, and construction management services for franchise real estate expansion.

FGP Commercial Leasing specializes in franchise real estate advisory services, offering franchisees and franchisors expert guidance on location strategy, lease negotiation using their Core Four Process, and construction oversight. Based in Westlake Village, FGP combines market research, mapping technology, and tenant representation to optimize franchise site selection and lease terms.
